name: writing-workflow-sops
description: Write Standard Operating Procedure documentation for workflows and save it as a Markdown file. Selects a full or lightweight SOP template by autonomy level (deterministic vs. guided or autonomous), then adapts it for workflow type (Manual, Augmented, Automated). Use when the user asks to write an SOP, document a workflow, create procedure documentation, or capture how a workflow is executed, and when the test skill offers a team workflow's SOP at go-live and the user says yes. Triggers on "write an SOP", "document this workflow", "create operating instructions", "how is this workflow executed".
